thread:
maria: Heads up — we're seeing elevated latency and dropped embeddings for eu-west. Hold all launch posts and the webinar promo until we confirm impact window. Need short status snippet + routing for inbound leads.

jack: Copy that. Holding paid and organic. Can you draft a 1-2 line status we can publish to status + a slightly longer email blurb for enterprise?

maria: Drafts below. Keep feedback tight.
```
Status (short): We are investigating increased latency affecting embeddings in eu-west. We've routed traffic to fallbacks and are working to restore normal performance. Next update in ~30m.

Enterprise email (long): We're experiencing elevated latency impacting embeddings in eu-west. Our engineering team has routed traffic to a lower-latency fallback model and is actively investigating root cause. If you rely on dedicated capacity or have running batch jobs, please pause new jobs until we confirm recovery. We'll provide an update in 30 minutes and again as the issue is resolved. For urgent problems, contact your CSM or reply to this email.
```

oliver: Timing proposal: initial public status at t+10, enterprise email at t+15, update at t+45, final resolution note when fixed. If recovery stalls, hold webinar promo for 24h.

emily: SDR routing: pause auto-qualification flows for inbound demo requests. Tag existing leads as "incident-affected" in HubSpot and set owner to on-call SDR queue. I can push a bulk note to queued leads once we have recovery ETA.

z oe: Social & paid: pause scheduled tweets + pause ad campaigns now. Organic posts set to draft. If we go >4h, we'll push a customer-facing thread explaining next steps and compensation options for impacted customers.

incident-bot: Incident acknowledged at 2178501234 — assigned to eng-runtime team.

jack: Quick ask — include line about automatic fallback to compatible model variant so customers know we kept the service alive (maybe with degraded quality).

maria: Good call. Add sentence in both status and email: "Traffic is temporarily routed to a compatible fallback model which may return lower-quality embeddings; normal model is being restored."

oliver: Approvals needed: legal for email wording, security if any data paths changed, ops for capacity notes, and CSMs for enterprise outreach. Estimated approvals in 20-30m if we move fast.

emily: I'll loop in CSMs + legal now with the draft. tagging @dave-sdr so he can prep inbound queue.

@dave-sdr: can you confirm you'll monitor the on-call queue and triage inbound demos?

dave-sdr: Yep — I'll watch the queue. Will set lead status and put quick note for follow-up post-recovery.

maria: Okay, next steps: 1) hold all promos (marketing) 2) publish short status in 10m (jack + oliver) 3) enterprise email at 15m (emily) 4) pause ads (zoe) 5) SDR routing (dave-sdr) 6) updates every 30-45m until resolved. We'll reconvene in #marketing in 20. :thumbsup:

jack: sending status in 10. :rocket:

emily: emailing CSMs now.

zoe: paused ads.

incident-bot: Update posted to internal incident log at 2178501302.
